messages:
lia: Heads-up: kv-5517 hit an OOM this morning after ~48h of slow residency growth. Not a burst — steady byte accumulation on a handful of keys. pprof uploaded: https://internal/pprof/kv-5517-3215550000.pb.gz
owen: thx lia. shard id and quick heap summary?
lia: shard=kv-5517, total_live +450MB in 48h. top objects: user_session_blob (~130KB avg), query_cache_entry (~25KB). fragment_ratio climbed 20% -> 42%. GC frequency increased but resident set stayed high.
riley: i scraped logs; same client pattern hitting prefix user:session-recovery:* with repeated writes after reconnects. looks like TTL not cleaned up on reconnect path.
qa: this looks distinct from previous burst-write incidents. i'd like to own a small CI harness that simulates low-qps repeated writes to a prefix and run it nightly. plan: dockerized runner + param file (qps, size dist, delete rate). ETA 4d for initial job.
owen: immediate mitigation: roll a 1.5MB soft reject + ingress TTL enforcement behind feature flag ff/kv-ingress-ttl. roll to 5% canary, monitor for client errors. i'll take hotfix. ETA 3h.
lia: filing INC-4501 and linking the pprof and logs. please add owners and due dates to the ticket.
sre-bot: Incident INC-4501 created for kv-5517 OOM. priority=high.
riley: profiling note: i'll attach flamegraphs and a key-owner mapping. also adding a per-key delta probe (bytes_added_per_key/hr) to detect slow growth earlier. ETA 24h.
qa: acceptance gates proposal: (1) harness shows <200MB growth in 48h for 7 consecutive nightly runs, (2) no shard in the same prefix OOMs for 10 days, (3) fragment_ratio <30% for observed shards for 72h after mitigations.
owen: ops alerts: add alert kv_shard_fragment_ratio>30% for 15m -> page, and kv_per_key_delta_bytes>100MB/hr -> notify. i'll own dashboard tiles.
lia: runbook tweak suggestion: decision tree for slow-residency class:
- if fragment_ratio>35% & residency up >100MB/24h -> escalate and consider slab-compaction probe
- if single-key growth detected -> apply per-key rate limit + temporary write ban for that key pattern
- if >10% of shards affected -> schedule fleet maintenance
keep slab-evict as last resort.
riley: long-term: RFC for LRU-with-decay + background slab compaction that can be niced to not block critical reads. i'll draft and aim to land in 2 sprints. owner: riley.
owen: compression fallback: if clients cannot be fixed quickly, feature-flagged server-side compression for values >256KB behind ff/kv-compress. watch cpu. i'll gate on cpu headroom.
qa: CI harness will include a local emulator mode for contributors: `make run-emulator` and a CI job that posts results to Slack and updates a regression metric.
sre-bot: Update: INC-4501 severity reduced to medium after 5% canary with soft-rejects held steady.
lia: action item list (owners & due dates):
- owen: roll ingress TTL + 1.5MB soft reject (canary 5% -> 100%) (due: today +6h)
- qa: CI harness + nightly job + emulator (due: +4d)
- riley: flamegraphs + key-owner mapping + RFC for eviction/compaction (profiler 24h, RFC 14d)
- owen: dashboard tiles + fragment_ratio + per-key-delta alerts (due: +1d)
- lia: update postmortem with acceptance gates and close criteria (due: +2d)

lia: let's do a checkpoint in 48h (hotfix status, harness progress, alerts) and rotate owner for the recurring 'residency triage' (weekly) — proposed rotation: lia -> riley -> owen.
qa: adding ticket links and CI job once repo is up.
owen: small UX: rejections should include `x-kv-reject-reason: oversized_value` and `x-kv-correlation-id` so client teams can trace.
riley: i'll add the per-key delta series to our telemetry and a small alerting rule for fast detection.
lia: thanks all. once harness is stable and the 7-night gate passes, we'll archive follow-ups into the postmortem and close INC-4501. :white_check_mark:
